inline.message: Unpacking result of dict.get without handling missing key causes TypeError when key is absent.
inline.suggested_fix: item = self._data.get(key); if item is None: return default; value, expires = item

summary.message: Cache.get now unconditionally unpacks the result of self._data.get(key), which returns None for missing keys, causing a TypeError. No tests cover the missing-key case.
summary.suggested_fix: Add a check: item = self._data.get(key); if item is None: return default; else: value, expires = item
